Name: Buildings Expanded
Author: tlitookilakin
Description:
[left][size=4][b]Features[/b][/size][/left]
[list]
[*][size=3][i]Fully buildable Ginger Island[/i]
You can now construct buildings on the Ginger Island farm once Willy's boat is repaired. Additionally, permanent structures like the island farmhouse, warp obelisk, shipping bin, and mailbox have been converted to real buildings which can be moved.[/size]
.[/*]
[*][size=3][i]New Builder
[/i]The island trader can now construct new buildings for you. The trader also offers a one-time upgrade for the island farmhouse which adds a usable bathroom and cellar.[/size]
.[/*]
[*][size=3][i]New buildings
[/i]More than a dozen new buildings with unique mechanics. Store large volumes of items in 3 tiers of stockpile, or boost your crops with magical field stones! Shelter your fruit trees through the seasons with arboreal cloches, or hook fish from anywhere with a magic pond! Fend off lightning, conjure rain, and much more![/size]
.[/*]
[*][size=3][i]Decorative flourishes
[/i]Features birds which perch on buildings, plus unique building-specific effects to really bring your farm to life.[/size][/*]
[/list]
